title: Survey every act auto mode refused, beyond the three allow lines
why: The owner asks whether the allow lines cover everything that gets refused.
note:
Coordinator 14:21 CST Nov 6, FULL (owner item 287 a): 359 of 360 cloud sessions since Nov 2, page 1 each (unread: session_013NEJL4LniUvGXrcRXsLkcK). 18 auto-mode refusals in about 6,216 judged acts (0.3%).
Recurring: force-with-lease push of a lane's own branch, 7 (fix: lane lease-sha-form-hint, PR #1324, prints the form the guard allows). Remote branch delete, 3 (refspec, git push --delete, gh api DELETE refs): the standing grant gives these to a Mac session. send_message carrying a status note or batch heads, 2.
Once each: .claude/CLAUDE.md edit, commit --amend, an Agent records edit, bash merge/install_from_main.sh, an archive probe push brief, rev-parse beside a refused push.
Reading: no new allow line. Answer to owner item 278: the force-push is the one recurring gap, and #1324 fixes it.
